1.t: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,

2.t: and those that are heavily laden,

5.t: What you [people] are promised is true:

7.t: by the sky with its pathways,

8.t: you differ in what you say––

9.t: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.

11.t: those steeped in error and unaware!

12.t: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’

13.t: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,

14.t: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’

15.t: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.

16.t: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:

18.t: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,

19.t: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.

20.t: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––

21.t: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––

22.t: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.

23.t: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.

24.t: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?

25.t: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’

26.t: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,

27.t: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,

28.t: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.

29.t: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’

30.t: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’

31.t: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’

32.t: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,

33.t: to bring down rocks of clay,

34.t: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’

35.t: We brought out such believers as were there-

36.t: We found only one household devoted to God-

37.t: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

38.t: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

39.t: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’

40.t: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.

41.t: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them

42.t: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.

43.t: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’

44.t: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:

45.t: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.

46.t: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!

47.t: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,

48.t: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-

49.t: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.

50.t: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-

51.t: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’

52.t: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’

53.t: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,

54.t: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-

55.t: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.

56.t: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:

57.t: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-

58.t: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.

59.t: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-

60.t: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
